title: Don Hernando's questions
brief: Don Hernando sits at his usual table and wants to know everything about you. Take his order, then answer his questions about what you like, what you play and where you're going on Sunday. Use usted with him; he uses tú with you.

turns.intent: He's your customer. Ask him politely what he'd like, using usted.

turns.npc: Un tinto, claro. ¿Y a ti? ¿Te gusta el tinto?
turns.npcEn: A black coffee, of course. And you? Do you like black coffee?
turns.intent: Say you don't like black coffee: you prefer hot chocolate.
accept: No me gusta el tinto. Prefiero el chocolate.
No, no me gusta. Prefiero el chocolate.
No me gusta mucho. Prefiero el chocolate.

turns.npcEn: Hot chocolate? Oh, no! And do you play football, Tomás?
turns.intent: Say no, you don't play football: you'd rather swim.
accept: No, no juego al fútbol. Prefiero nadar.
No juego al fútbol: prefiero nadar.
No, no juego fútbol. Prefiero nadar.

turns.npc: ¿Nadar? ¿En Bogotá? ¡Qué frío! Yo no juego: yo camino. ¿Y adónde vas el domingo?
turns.npcEn: Swim? In Bogotá? So cold! I don't play: I walk. And where are you going on Sunday?
turns.intent: Say you're going to the park with Vale.
accept: El domingo voy al parque con Vale.
Voy a ir al parque con Vale.

turns.npc: ¿Con Vale? ¡Qué chévere! Yo no entiendo el fútbol de hoy. Es muy aburrido.
turns.npcEn: With Vale? How nice! I don't understand today's football. It's very boring.
turns.intent: Agree: you don't understand it either.
accept: Tampoco entiendo el fútbol de hoy.
